method: Static ARM64 symbol/disassembly inspection with nm and llvm-objdump; application not executed

findings.interpretation: The inspected initializer reads a configurable properties file and inserts parsed hex-prefix entries into a hash index; no embedded OUI table was recovered.
The inspected catalog lookup delegates through a remote-client path with user-profile context; this does not prove every recognition path is cloud-only.

limits: No service contacted, credentials used, runtime caches read, recognition records recovered, or proprietary implementation/data incorporated.
